ops.title: board: cold provisioning is per-record; make it set-based
ops.description: BoardIndex.reconcile runs about 15 statements per changed record on a cold provision, plus boardAnnotateErrors calling BoardSnapshot.OpenAmong once per record. #329 made every statement indexed (the effects/openers join and three category-less lookups had scanned the scope), but TestBoardFullPopulationSQLPredicateWork still takes about 7.5 minutes and TestBoardColdBackfillSQLPredicateWork 100k timed out once at the package's 10m limit (run 41624794646) and passed in 6 minutes the next time. Fix the cause: provision with set-based INSERT ... SELECT over records and batch the annotation pass per drive while keeping per-record annotation errors.

ops.text: The Board full-population and cold backfill step finishes well inside the 10m package timeout
